basic_info.description: Nestled in a prime Lower Pacific Heights location, just a block from Fillmore Street's vibrant shops and dining, this 1,104 sqft two-story condo offers the comfort and feel of a townhome. The well-maintained home features two upstairs bedrooms, including a master suite with an oversized closet and en-suite bath. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living with a large private patio and an additional balcony off the kitchen. This elevator building includes secure garage parking, private storage, and in-unit laundry for added convenience. A perfect urban retreat in an unbeatable location.
